debug_mode.description: Enable debug logging for rkdeveloptool operations

vid_pid_filter.description: VID:PID string to filter connected Rockchip devices (e.g., '2207:350a'). Empty for all.

image_dir.description: Default directory to look for image files if not specified in operations

operations.description: List of default operations to perform. Items are flat maps with 'command' (required), 'args' (optional list), and 'output_file' (optional string). Valid commands: list, read, write, read-partition, write-partition, boot, reset, reboot, test-device, upgrade-loader, erase-flash, shutdown, read-flash-id, read-flash-info, read-chip-info, read-capability, pack, unpack, tag-spl, write-partition-table, write-parameter, reboot-maskrom.

operation_delay_seconds.description: Seconds to wait between executing operations
